MatchingStatus.name: Matching Status
MatchingStatus.definition: Status of matching of a trade.

AffirmationStatus.name: Affirmation Status
AffirmationStatus.definition: Status of affirmation of a trade.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Status of an investment fund transaction.

ReplacementProcessingStatus.name: Replacement Processing Status
ReplacementProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the processing status of the replacement request.

CancellationStatus.name: Cancellation Status
CancellationStatus.definition: Status of the cancellation of a trade.

CancellationRight.name: Cancellation Right
CancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of an investor with respect to an order.

TransferStatus.name: Transfer Status
TransferStatus.definition: Status of the transfer is accepted, sent to next party, matched, already executed, or settled.

AllegedStatus.name: Alleged Status
AllegedStatus.definition: Provides the status of an allegement.

CollateralAllocationStatus.name: Collateral Allocation Status
CollateralAllocationStatus.definition: Provides the status of allocation of collateral to cover the instruction.

RepoCallRequestStatus.name: Repo Call Request Status
RepoCallRequestStatus.definition: Specifies additional information about the status of the repurchase agreement call processed instruction.

SettlementConditionModificationStatus.name: Settlement Condition Modification Status
SettlementConditionModificationStatus.definition: Provides the status of the securities settlement condition modification request.

MatchingProcess.name: Matching Process
MatchingProcess.definition: Specifies the matching status of a trade.

TradeConfirmationStatus.name: Trade Confirmation Status
TradeConfirmationStatus.definition: Specifies whether the contract was electronically confirmed, non-electronically confirmed or remains unconfirmed.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reasons for the status. It is derived from the relationship between Status and Status Reason.

SecuritiesTrade.name: Securities Trade
SecuritiesTrade.definition: Specifies the trade which has a specific status.

RelatedSecuritiesTransfer.name: Related Securities Transfer
RelatedSecuritiesTransfer.definition: Transfer operation for which a status is provided
